nodes.label: The Method 1.6 Mathematical Compendium
nodes.rationale: Written from the register itself so it cannot drift from what the book holds; 299 objects, 18 roots, 297 settled, 2 unfinished.

nodes.label: Verification coverage, stated rather than implied
nodes.rationale: 103 verifier assertions name 46 objects and none touch the other 167; 91 check fields merely repeat the object's key and 18 are empty, so a check field present is not a verification performed. Register 849.

nodes.label: The cycle — X(n+1) = R(X_n union Delta_n)
nodes.rationale: The whole work is one recursion (SS14.5.2) halting when the increment is already implied; it has never halted.

nodes.label: The closure-to-seed ratio as falsifier (15.6:1)
nodes.rationale: 265 held against 17 underived; if a genuinely new object entered that nothing derived, the seed would move — that is the test.

nodes.label: R4 — the four-orientation closure operator
nodes.rationale: Closure over all four staircase orientations; E - E4 is the orientation cost.

nodes.label: E — the ordinal defect
nodes.rationale: E(X) = |R(X)| - |X|. Naming the gap between a set and its closure as a defect is the book's own step; the operator itself is Moore 1910.

nodes.label: E4 — the defect under R4, and the orientation cost
d — the lattice metric on cells
seed — least G with R(G) = X (NP-hard)
nodes.rationale: The seed problem is minimum set cover, NP-complete (Karp 1972), with a greedy ln n approximation (Johnson 1974).

nodes.label: pi — the Hopf shape map
nodes.rationale: Cited and used as found rather than introduced (Montgomery 2014; Hopf 1931).

nodes.label: N8 — the minimal polynomial of a sum of three square roots
nodes.rationale: Cited and used as found (Lagrange 1770).

nodes.label: A language is a coordinate system, and E is the cost of translation
nodes.rationale: The test of necessity is not that each language is available but that each states a quantity the others cannot; the agreement of the languages on Lambda = 976 across all ten pairs is the result, the list is not.

nodes.label: The analysis language
nodes.rationale: Alone gives F(-1) = 2, an alternating sum a set cannot express; supplies the cell count without enumerating.

nodes.label: The order language
nodes.rationale: The only language that states a DEFECT; every result beginning 'E =' begins here.

nodes.label: The geometry language
nodes.rationale: Alone states the void per interval, which is where the exclusion principle shows.

nodes.label: The binary language
nodes.rationale: Alone says what the space was before any constraint touched it; every density and compression ratio is a fraction of the box.

nodes.label: The information language
nodes.rationale: Gives the compression — 139 cells printed for every one in the seed; order knows the seed is seven, only description length says what seven buys.

nodes.label: The statistics language
nodes.rationale: Recovers Lambda exactly from pairwise marginals and can do nothing else; reports E = 0 on the periodic table where R reports 36, because marginals cannot see a hole. Necessary for one purpose and useless for another, and knowing which is the point of having it.

nodes.label: The algebra language
nodes.rationale: Gives derivability — whether a bound follows from the others is a question about an ideal, which no count can express.

nodes.label: The documentary language
nodes.rationale: Has no closure operator at all — 'has anyone said this before' cannot be bounded by computation, so a precedent question can be bounded and never settled.

nodes.label: The metric defect E_W
nodes.rationale: Distinct from the ordinal defect E; empty for Lambda because a cell of Lambda is an arrangement carrying no number, which is why the book needed only E. For Lambda_spectra the two differ, and the gap is the cells that are placed and unvalued.

nodes.label: The recovery operator R
nodes.rationale: Neither the operator form (Moore 1910) nor the monotone-staircase constraint class (Deville, Barette & Van Hentenryck 1999) is new; what is new is reading E as a defect.

nodes.label: The STEP operator
nodes.rationale: Must be derived from MEASURED cells only: re-deriving from the walked result tightens the iso-s step spuriously, because the walked values were generated by that step.

nodes.label: The walk — the valuation closure
nodes.rationale: Extensive and idempotent with zero drift; monotone except at one cell in 1,345, where a measured zero blocks a multiplicative route — so adding a measurement can REMOVE a walked cell.

nodes.label: Projection onto coordinate i
nodes.rationale: The relational projection operator of Codd 1970; the deepest root of every chain in the register.

nodes.label: The anchor — redundancy anchoring
nodes.rationale: Keeping every route and reading the spread as the error makes the check come from the index disagreeing with itself rather than from an outside formula.

nodes.label: The three blindnesses
nodes.rationale: A representation cannot state what its own coordinates cannot distinguish: statistics sees marginals only, analysis has no order in it, a multiplicative algebra is monotone in each factor by construction and so returns 205/205 where the data has eleven genuine exceptions.

nodes.label: The certificate condition
nodes.rationale: An open index does not close itself except where a certificate exhibits an admitted operation on its coordinate system reaching a fixed point of R.

nodes.label: Lambda's seed — seven cells
nodes.rationale: 976 cells from seven, 139 to 1; five heuristics agreeing on 7 against a lower bound of 5 is the measurement, not a proof of minimality.

nodes.label: The open-index form, seed + E
nodes.rationale: Compresses only where E is much smaller than |X|.

nodes.label: The closure theorem, E(Lambda) = 0
nodes.rationale: E = 0 says the index equals its own closure; a tree-structured constraint graph is why (Freuder 1982).

nodes.label: The generating function F
nodes.rationale: The tree has no cycles, so the multivariate sum factorises.

nodes.label: The alternating specialisation F(-1) = 2
nodes.rationale: The free box vanishes exactly while the tree's couplings clip every potentially vanishing range, leaving a residue of 2; the residue, the rank skew and the eight self-dual survivors are one fact reached by three routes.

nodes.label: The definition of Lambda
nodes.rationale: The eight constraints are the shell-structure rules of Bohr 1913 and Pauli 1925 written as inequalities on integer coordinates; figures at other caps must say so.

nodes.label: Order dimension of Lambda-8 (Dushnik-Miller)
nodes.rationale: Seven, not eight: g contributes no independent antichain member because every g generator sits above the q-atom, so the order pays seven dimensions for eight axes; the earlier figure 8 was asserted, never derived, and is corrected.

nodes.label: The void
nodes.rationale: The difference between a box count and the cells it actually contains; 46.4% of a typical interval is admitted by the box and refused by Lambda.

nodes.label: The void-free fraction
nodes.rationale: The constraints are positively dependent by Chebyshev's sum inequality and the dependence runs only along the constraint tree; the factor above independence is exactly the product of the six edge lifts, and it is cap-dependent because the lifts are.

nodes.label: The staircase algebra of a closed index
nodes.rationale: E(R) = 0 iff the held set is an intersection of monotone staircases, so a closed index is a system of inequalities and its cells are the lattice points satisfying them.

nodes.label: The refusal map
nodes.rationale: That bare ionisation energies refuse the bracket at the s2-p1 opening and the p3-p4 first pairing is a statement about what a bracket needs, not about the data.

nodes.label: The price of a layout
nodes.rationale: Hydrogen's placement is free and helium's costs 16, and the two are not additive — the cost measured is of the CHOICE of layout.

nodes.label: The price V — the bracket's width against its error
The five-sigma admissibility threshold
nodes.rationale: Fixes where the bracket may be applied at all, r = 2Z^2R/(nu^3 sigma) >= 5.

nodes.label: The core at fifteen letters
nodes.rationale: That the core is unchanged while the multiplicity grows is the measurement; the notion of an irreducible infeasible subsystem is Chinneck & Dravnieks'.

nodes.label: The core at nine letters
nodes.rationale: E = 30 is the arity-4 constraint-language defect, not the envelope defect of the cell set, which is 3,040 — the two must not be conflated.

nodes.label: The electromagnetic quotient
nodes.rationale: A selection rule is a quotient by a symmetry, not an extension of the state space; adjoining EM coordinates to Lambda gives E = 3,900.

nodes.label: The spin diagonal
nodes.rationale: Delta S = 0 is a diagonal, hence two monotone one-parent bounds, and imposing it preserves E = 0 at four cap settings.

nodes.label: The channel equation, first form
nodes.rationale: Superseded by the final form at register 1205, but kept on dependence lines because the graph records the order of establishment, not present support.

nodes.label: The channel equation, final form
nodes.rationale: Four fitted numbers and every input from the ground state or the periodic table; every term has a prior source and the equation assembles them rather than introducing any. It values all 1,648 cells R places, where the walk valued none.

nodes.label: The deficit term — the penetration deficit
nodes.rationale: The decay is set by the atom's SIZE rather than its charge, and a universal decay constant fits neither K I nor Sr I — a factor of seven apart.

nodes.label: Seaton's term — the polarisation term
nodes.rationale: Must be gated OFF below l = 4, where K(l) is small and the term drives the fit to rms 39.3; subsumed at register 1204 by the Janet collapse coordinate.

nodes.label: The validated domain
nodes.rationale: Validated in the verified-plus-possible region and extrapolated outside it; the 277-channel fit beats the 311-channel one because nine-tenths of the Ne-dependence was open-shell contamination.

nodes.label: The entrant operator ent(Z)
nodes.rationale: The operator Chapter 27 said a non-closing index requires; sign-exact by construction, with the margin to the runner-up recorded at every step as its own error bar. 107 of 107 against measured ground configurations.

nodes.label: The ordering law, five clauses
nodes.rationale: Clause 2's exception set {La, Ac, Th} is derived by the collapse condition rather than listed.

nodes.label: The collapse condition
nodes.rationale: Occupies exactly the domain where Chapter 34's corridor is silent; near the transition a sign at SCF tolerance is branch content, not noise.

nodes.label: The pinned-channel theorem (no g block)
nodes.rationale: A relation the data cannot violate is defending something — here, the nonexistence of a g period through Z = 125.

nodes.label: The state-dependent multiplier identity
nodes.rationale: A residual of large cancelling terms rather than a convergence artefact; it reclassified a registered instrument fault as derived content.

nodes.label: The exact-quartic decomposition
nodes.rationale: Five evaluations determine every Taylor coefficient with zero truncation error; the floating-point floor is the only limit and it is stated, not implied.

nodes.label: The defect closed: chord = rot + perp
nodes.rationale: The endpoint-Hessian term is twenty to five hundred times too small for the residual it was hypothesised to explain — a hypothesis falsified by the clause that scored HIT, and kept.

nodes.label: The twin operator, c to infinity
nodes.rationale: Every one of the eleven disagreements is an error against nature, since the relativistic operator scores 107/107 — measured rather than asserted.

nodes.label: Shape space and the shape sphere
nodes.rationale: The one new root the three-body family adds, and it is standard mathematics cited as found.

nodes.label: The index Lambda-3
nodes.rationale: Cited theorems assembled; the assembly is this work's. The maximal forbidden case of Chapter 18 is the solved case, because what is forbidden is exactly what Poincare excludes.

nodes.label: The chains — longest derivation paths in the register
nodes.rationale: Depth 17 is the Loewdin solution's longest path, running from projection onto coordinate i through the channel equation to the defect closed at zero residue.

nodes.label: Half-sided modular inclusion on a non-expanding horizon (unfinished)
nodes.rationale: Not unfinished for want of a proof attempt: the horizon's definition supplies a state condition at background order and leaves a gap at perturbation order, and that gap is the object. Sorce 2024 closes the geometric route by construction, so the route that remains is algebraic.

nodes.label: The exchange factor (unfinished)
nodes.rationale: Withdrawn at register 1168 because the fitted sign is opposite the measured one, and left as ASSERTED rather than removed because the term is real and the form is wrong. A uniform multiplicative s can only give 0 of 66 or 66 of 66 triplet-above-singlet pairs; the measurement is neither.

nodes.label: The bibliography — 156 works, 1669-2026
nodes.rationale: The book claims nothing new where an earlier result will do; ten rows read out of callout text were removed at register 1736 and six more at register 1891, so the count fell 172 to 162 to 156.

nodes.label: The corridor — a system of linear inequalities
nodes.rationale: The linear programming is standard; what is this work's is that the coefficients are node counts, so endpoints lie in Q(sqrt N) and take only nineteen distinct values, and that all 106 intervals are non-empty.

nodes.label: a_cross = (sqrt(n-1) + sqrt(n-4))/3
nodes.rationale: The 3 in the denominator is p_g - p_r, invariant across the table.

nodes.label: The observability boundary
nodes.rationale: An index closes when its cells are enumerable; what it cannot supply is exactly what requires an operator. One confirming instance, falsifiable, tested once.

nodes.label: Lambda_spectra's closure, and what the limit leaves
nodes.rationale: Beyond-limit cells are past the limit, not defects; the split was first reported as 47/11 using the observed table's edge Z = 108 against the synthesised 118, corrected at register 1426. E = 11 and every absent cell is named.

nodes.label: Rival = donor iff the donor is not full
nodes.rationale: Holds 12 of 12 with no fitted term; Pd is its own control — the only s donor that is not full, and it sits with the d and f donors, so the rule is about occupancy and not angular momentum.

nodes.label: Lambda_law — seven laws on (law, carrier)
nodes.rationale: The closing carrier order is monotone in how LOCAL the variable is; what only this index contributes is THE CARRIER — fitting a law in the wrong carrier took an l-spread from a spurious r2 of 0.868 to a real 0.356.

nodes.label: Lambda_const — fourteen constants on (role, carrier)
nodes.rationale: The role axis orders by how much physics a number has absorbed: every centre is a small integer or half-integer and no scale is. beta = 2/3 is load-bearing and is the one that is attributed.

nodes.label: An index mixing object with observer cannot close
nodes.rationale: `standing` cannot be a coordinate: with attributed/derived/measured/fitted on an axis the index closes at no ordering, without it at once. Four occurrences of one mistake — standing, origin, kind, state — stated here as a rule; the refusal is the more useful half.
